description: Confirmation panel shown after a signer finishes, reflecting either a completed or waiting-for-others state. Offers actions to download the signed document, send a copy by email, and an optional custom action. Announces through a role="status" region on its content (title + description), optionally focuses the title after the first render (FocusTitleOnRender) and colours only the hero circle in the waiting state.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Optional host content rendered between the description and the action row (Signing redesign phase 3) — for example a submission status timeline or a next-steps hint.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: FocusTitleOnRender
parameters.description: Whether the panel moves focus onto its title after the first render (default true) so assistive technology announces the completion status. Hosts that render the panel next to other content — or several instances on one screen — pass false: a programmatic focus move from each instance would yank the signer's scroll/focus to the last rendered panel.

parameters.name: IsWaitingForOthers
parameters.description: Whether the signer is done but the submission is waiting for other recipients.

parameters.name: OnCustomAction
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the custom action is clicked.

parameters.name: OnDownload
parameters.description: Callback invoked when download is requested and no DownloadUrl is set.

parameters.name: OnSendCopy
parameters.description: Callback invoked when sending a copy is requested.

parameters.name: ShowSendCopy
parameters.description: Whether the send-copy action is shown.
